reuse.why: Computes expectedAmount by calling the existing shared getScheduledAmount helper that the UI schedule list, balance and mobile views already use.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the range/missing/number rule stays in the one shared helper.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts, where the API's external schedule shape is built, with the handler type updated accordingly.

scope.why: Only the API model, its result type, a focused test and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: A one-line delegation to the shared helper plus a separate read-only result type keeps the input type unchanged and the rule in one place.
